# ORA by Aurem CTO
> AI engineer that reads your GitHub repo,
> writes production code, and commits directly.
> No IDE needed. Flat pricing. No token billing.

## What is ORA?
ORA (by Aurem CTO) is a web-based AI developer
tool. Developers connect their GitHub repository,
describe a task in plain English, and ORA reads
the relevant files, writes the fix, runs security
checks, and commits directly to GitHub — all in
one turn.

## Key facts
- URL: https://auremcto.com
- Also known as: Aurem CTO, ORA
- Category: AI developer tool / autonomous coding agent
- Updated: Iter 175 (June 2026)
- Pricing: $9 Starter / $19 Pro / $49 Team (flat/month)
- No per-token billing
- No IDE required

## Core capabilities (Iter 175)
- Reads GitHub repos via PAT authentication
- Writes production-ready code (Swift/Pro/Maxx modes)
- Commits directly to GitHub
- Project Brain V2: remembers codebase structure
- Warm Start: pre-loads repo context on project select
- Codebase Knowledge Graph: visual file dependency map
- Post-task security scanner: finds secrets + broken imports
- Live phase chips: shows exactly what ORA is doing
- MCP server: integrates with Claude Desktop + Claude.ai
- Ask Advisor panel: casual AI assistant for questions
- WhatsApp integration: ship code via WhatsApp message

## AI mode routing
- Swift ($9): Kimi K2.7 writes, Kimi K2.5 reviews
- Pro ($19): Kimi K2.7 writes, Kimi Thinking reviews
- Maxx ($49): Claude Sonnet writes, security always Claude
- Security scan: always Claude Sonnet (non-negotiable)

## MCP integration
- Endpoint: https://auremcto.com/api/aurem-dev/mcp
- Protocol: MCP 2025-03-26 Streamable HTTP
- Tools: list_projects, ship_code,
         get_task_status, get_recent_commits
- Auth: JWT or sk-aurem-* API key
- Discovery: https://auremcto.com/.well-known/mcp

## Competitors comparison
- vs GitHub Copilot: ORA commits to GitHub directly,
  Copilot only suggests in IDE
- vs Cursor: ORA works from browser/mobile,
  Cursor requires desktop IDE
- vs Devin: ORA costs $9-49/mo flat,
  Devin costs $500+ per task
- vs Claude Code: ORA has flat pricing,
  Claude Code bills per token
